title: Band edges of the almost Mathieu operator at Liouville scales
description: We study gap decay for the supercritical almost Mathieu operator on both sides of the Liouville threshold. Write L=log(lambda), beta=beta(alpha), x=2 beta/L, and let rho be the liminf of -log|G_m|/(L|m|). For 0<x<1 we prove rho<=1-x. At beta-attaining convergents and every fixed positive integer D, the gap with label -Dq_n sgn(delta_n) has width at least c_D kappa_n^(1-D)/P_n'(E_n), where delta_n=q_n alpha-p_n and kappa_n=(2 pi q_n)^2 lambda^(q_n)|delta_n|^2. The proof keeps the energy-dependent Feshbach self-energy, constructs a common covariant well family with a globally gapped continuation, and resolves the fixed-D avoided crossing by relative tunnelling estimates. Liu-Shi's theorem and IDS-preserving Aubry duality give 1/C<=rho<=1-x<1 for 0<x<=2/C, with an absolute constant C. This contradicts their stated expectation of the sharper upper gap bound in that overlapping range; it does not contradict their theorem. Equality rho=1-x remains open. Above the threshold, our earlier polynomial lower subsequences give rho=0 for finite beta>L/2, and a surplus argument covers beta=infinity. The equality line x=1 remains open. The reductions use rational top-band Green decay, translated Wannier frames and exact finite-box counts. No computation enters a proof.
